description_en: Updates the configurations of a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance
description_zh: 修改云连接网的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-cloud-connect-network --ccn-id ccn-l9340rlu5ens00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudConnectNetwork

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CCN instance
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the CCN instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
云连接网的名称。 

长度为2~128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，半角句号（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-），但不能以`http:// `或` https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the CCN instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The description must start with a letter but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
云连接网的描述。 

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或 `https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the CCN instance is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the SAG instances associated with the same CCN instance to communicate with each other.

enable: yes

disable: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许绑定同一个云连接网的智能接入网关实例互通。

enable：允许。
disable：不允许
parameters.name: interworking_status
